NO DOWNLOADS. NO SIGN-UP. JUST A FROG WITH AMBITION.

FROG SCHOOL / 30 SECONDS

Load. Leap. Repeat.

Rear feet are your springs. Hold either foot—or both—for more power. Release all held rear feet to jump.

Front hands steer. Hold the left or right hand before a jump to line up, or in the air to adjust your landing.

Watch the landing ring. Green means your current aim reaches a lily pad. Too little power lands short; too much overshoots.

The first pads are generous. Later, they shrink and spread out. Your best distance stays on this device.

Keyboard: A/D steer · J/K rear feet · SPACE charges both · Escape pauses.
